tcp.summary: The TCP three-way handshake, then the first data.

messages.note: The client picks a starting sequence number.
The server acknowledges it and picks its own.
Both sides now know both numbers: the connection is open.

tcp-lost.summary: A TCP handshake whose SYN-ACK is lost: the client's timer fires and it sends the SYN again.

props.title: A handshake that loses its SYN-ACK

messages.note: The client opens: its first sequence number is 100.
The reply is dropped on the way back.
Same sequence number: it is the same request.

dns.summary: A resolver asking a name server for an address.
